$comment: EXP-1291/NEW-1: the FIRST prompt of every new session is composed on the SERVER (`sessions.brief`, read by the device at pickup), so all four clients and every start path (composer, Start on an issue, an action, a trigger firing, an agent spawn, a follow-up child) produce byte-identical input. composeBrief(input) (TS reference packages/domain-contract/src/session-brief.ts; the server calls it, no client mirror needed beyond reading this spec) replays `cases`: sections in this order, each '## <heading>' + a blank line + its body, joined by a blank line, empty sections omitted: Request (the person's text, trimmed; image embed lines kept) · Plan (EXP-1280: a session started in plan mode, `planMode`; body = `plan`; right behind the Request so the byte cap can never trim it) · Action '<name>' (the action body trimmed, then for each filled input in declaration order '- <label>: <display>' after an 'Inputs:' line and a blank line) · Issues (one '- <identifier> <title>' per issue in link order) · Parent (a child only: templates `parent` with {title} = the parent's title, {depth}/{maxDepth} = its depth and contract sessionsSend.treeMaxDepth, {branch} = the parent's branch; without a branch the `parentNoBranch` template). Nothing at all = `empty`. The result is cut at sessionsSend.briefMaxBytes UTF-8 bytes at the last newline that fits, ending in a '…' line.
parent: You are a sub-session (depth {depth} of {maxDepth}) of "{title}". Base your work on its branch: `git fetch origin {branch} && git reset --hard origin/{branch}` before any edit, then open your PR with `pr_open({base: "{branch}"})`.
parentNoBranch: You are a sub-session (depth {depth} of {maxDepth}) of "{title}".
